'''''Silene littorea''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] within the family [[Caryophyllaceae]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last1=Valle|first1=José Carlos Del|last2=Buide|first2=Mª Luisa|last3=Whittall|first3=Justen B.|last4=Valladares|first4=Fernando|last5=Narbona|first5=Eduardo|date=2020-06-18|title=UV radiation increases phenolic compound protection but decreases reproduction in Silene littorea|journal=PLOS ONE|language=en|volume=15|issue=6|article-number=e0231611|doi=10.1371/journal.pone.0231611|issn=1932-6203|pmc=7302690|pmid=32555603|bibcode=2020PLoSO..1531611D|doi-access=free}}</ref> The species has the [[Gynodioecy–Gynomonoecy|gynodioecy–gynomonoecy]] [[sexual system]]. It is one of the most studied species with this sexual system.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Casimiro-Soriguer|first1=Inés|last2=Buide|first2=Maria L.|last3=Narbona|first3=Eduardo|date=2015-01-01|title=Diversity of sexual systems within different lineages of the genus Silene|journal=AoB Plants|volume=7|article-number=plv037|doi=10.1093/aobpla/plv037|pmid=25862920|issn=2041-2851|pmc=4433491}}</ref>

== Description ==
''Silene littorea'' is a low growing [[Annual plant|annual]] plant reaching heights of around 15 cm tall.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Perez |first=Charlie |date=2016-04-15 |title=Silene littorea Brot. |url=https://floraofgibraltar.myspecies.info/taxonomy/term/335/descriptions |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250927135820/https://floraofgibraltar.myspecies.info/taxonomy/term/335/descriptions |archive-date=2025-09-27 |access-date=2025-09-27 |website=Flora of Gibraltar [[Gibraltar Botanic Gardens]] [[Gibraltar Ornithological & Natural History Society]]}}</ref> The plant is covered in sticky hairs known as [[Trichome|trichomes]].<ref name=":1" /> 

=== Flowers ===
Silene littorea flowers are about 2 cm in diameter and possess five petals.<ref name=":1" /> The species exhibits flower colour [[Polymorphism (biology)|polymorphism]]: with light pink, dark pink and white flowered colour morphs being present within ''Silene littorea'' populations.<ref>Casimiro-Soriguer, Ines & Narbona, Eduardo & Buide, Mª Luisa & Del Valle, Jose & Whittall, Justen. (2016). Transcriptome and Biochemical Analysis of a Flower Color Polymorphism in Silene littorea (Caryophyllaceae). Frontiers in Plant Science. 7. 10.3389/fpls.2016.00204. </ref> The flowers of ''Silene lottorea'' can either be female or [[Hermaphrodite|hermaphordite]].<ref name=":2">Guitián, Pablo & Medrano, Monica. (2000). Sex expression and fruit set in Silene littorea (Caryophyllaceae): Variation among populations. Nordic Journal of Botany. 20. 467 - 473. 10.1111/j.1756-1051.2000.tb01589.x. </ref> An individual plant can possess any three sexual [[Phenotype|phenotypes]], with plants possessing either female only flowers, hermaphorodite only flowers or even a mix of both.<ref name=":2" />

== Distribution ==
The species is native to [[Morocco]], [[Portugal]], [[Spain]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=Silene littorea Brot. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science|url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:157697-1|access-date=2021-09-24|website=Plants of the World Online|language=en}}</ref> The population of this species has been observed to be declining in Spain.<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Frankham|first1=Richard|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=vLZKnsCk89wC&q=Silene+littorea&pg=PA409|title=Introduction to Conservation Genetics|last2=Ballou|first2=Jonathan D.|last3=Briscoe|first3=David Anthony|date=2010|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0-521-87847-0|page=409|language=en}}</ref> The species is rare in [[Gibraltar|Gibraltr]] and restricted to eastern sandy slopes.<ref name=":1" />

== Habitat ==
''Silene littorea'' grows in sandy soils on coastal locations.<ref name=":1" /> It can often be found inhabiting coastal [[Dune|sand dunes]].<ref>Del Valle, Jose & Buide, Mª Luisa & Whittall, Justen & Narbona, Eduardo. (2018). Phenotypic plasticity in light-induced flavonoids varies among tissues in Silene littorea (Caryophyllaceae). Environmental and Experimental Botany. 153. 10.1016/j.envexpbot.2018.05.014. </ref>

== Subspecies ==
The following [[subspecies]] are recognised:<ref name=":3" />

* ''Silene littorea'' ''adscendens''
* ''Silene littorea'' ''littorea''
